record.question: What is the arbitrary limit to define epidemic threshold of common diseases?
options: Two standard errors from the endemic occurrence
Two standard deviation from the endemic occurrence
One standard errors from the endemic occurrence
One standard deviation from the endemic occurrence
record.explanation: Answer B: Two standard deviation from the endemic occurrence. An epidemic threshold is often operationally set at approximately two standard deviations above the expected endemic level, though methods vary by disease and surveillance system. Source/context note: An arbitrary threshold is a surveillance convention; actual outbreak thresholds are disease-specific. Reference: https://www.who.int/emergencies/outbreak-toolkit. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
